illustration.description: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration in a flat vector style with thin dark outlines, soft pastel fills and a light grain texture. A woman with blonde hair in a messy top bun and a small hair tie, wearing a coral-pink crew-neck t-shirt, stands in a half-body pose. She holds a blue toothbrush with white foam in her mouth, lifting her right arm up to the side of her face. Her eyebrows are furrowed in a grumpy, concentrated expression, with simple dot eyes and a small nose. Lighting is soft and even, with no cast shadows. The background is plain off-white and empty.

texts.text: YOU START USING THE WRONG HAND

graphics.description: Short wavy orange motion squiggle above and to the left of the raised arm, suggesting shaking/brushing movement
Longer wavy orange motion squiggle to the left of the arm, suggesting shaking/brushing movement
